insert into ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_ledger( tenant_id, member_id, warehouse_id, product_id, change_type, change_qty, reason, operator_name, create_time, is_delete ) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{warehouseId}, #{productId}, #{changeType}, #{changeQty}, #{reason}, #{operator}, now(), 0)
mapper.select: select #{poolId} as poolId, #{warehouseId} as warehouseId, coalesce((select sum(b.on_hand_qty) from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_balance b inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = b.product_id and p.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and p.member_id = b.member_id and p.stock_pool_id = #{poolId} and p.stock_mode = 'quantity' and p.is_delete = 0 and (not exists (select 1 from ry_business.ry_rental_stock_pool_compatibility c where c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and c.member_id = p.member_id and c.pool_id = p.stock_pool_id and c.is_delete = 0) or exists (select 1 from ry_business.ry_rental_stock_pool_compatibility c where c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and c.member_id = p.member_id and c.pool_id = p.stock_pool_id and c.model_id = p.model_id and c.is_delete = 0)) where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and b.member_id = #{memberId} and b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and b.stock_status = 'available' and b.is_delete = 0), 0) + coalesce((select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_asset_sn s inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id and p.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and p.member_id = s.member_id and p.stock_pool_id = #{poolId} and p.stock_mode = 'serial' and p.is_delete = 0 and (not exists (select 1 from ry_business.ry_rental_stock_pool_compatibility c where c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and c.member_id = p.member_id and c.pool_id = p.stock_pool_id and c.is_delete = 0) or exists (select 1 from ry_business.ry_rental_stock_pool_compatibility c where c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and c.member_id = p.member_id and c.pool_id = p.stock_pool_id and c.model_id = p.model_id and c.is_delete = 0)) where s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and s.member_id = #{memberId} and s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and s.asset_status = 'available' and s.is_delete = 0), 0) as availableQty
